query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.open_id, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medication_reminders mr WHERE mr.user_id = u.id) as reminder_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM symptom_entries se WHERE se.user_id = u.id) as entry_count
FROM users u
ORDER BY u.id;
